title: 스토킹범죄 사건의 심리 및 재판 등에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
title_original: 스토킹범죄 사건의 심리 및 재판 등에 관한 규칙
full_text: Article 3 (Counsel for Victims) Where counsel for a victim states an opinion during questioning of a suspect before arrest, evidence preservation proceedings, a preparatory hearing for trial, or trial proceedings pursuant to Article 17-4 (3) of the Act, Chapter III of the Rules on Hearings and Trials of Sexual Violence Crime Cases, etc. and Protection of Victims shall apply mutatis mutandis.
